decisions.statement: A page moved into another folder keeps the slug that page had.
Every file a page keeps beside that page moves with the page.
A body naming a path that moved is repointed in the same answer.
A folder already with a body at a path the move would write is refused.
Nothing here changes the data a page states.
The move is left to the mechanical change moving that kind of page.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one page and the files beside that page moved into another folder
